title: Somalia Conflict Tracker Update — Fri Jun 5, 2026
summary: Mogadishu descended into the worst urban warfare in over a decade on June 4, with government forces deploying heavy artillery against opposition positions amid protests against President Mohamud's post-term rule — UN Secretary-General Guterres expressed alarm and the US called for restraint. On June 5, the government claimed order restored in two districts as Turkish F-16s flew over the capital and Al Jazeera published analysis warning Somalia's crisis was deepening. A fourth vessel was reportedly hijacked off Garacad on June 5, potentially raising the piracy crisis to 4 simultaneous vessels alongside 44 hostages still held across Honour 25 (Day 41), Sward (Day 40), and MT Eureka (Day 34). Al-Shabaab held Adan Yabal in Hiiraan for Day 47 — the longest uncontested insurgent occupation since 2022 — as the opposition 30-day countdown reached Day 21 with 9 days remaining before Deni's June 14 parallel authority deadline.
